unsupported: The company began as a regional snack maker focused on producing potato chips from whole fresh potatoes, though the names of its original founders are not publicly documented.
The company manufactures kettle-style potato chips using a low-and-slow cooking method that leaves the potato skins on.
Mister Bee serves the snack food market, distributing its chips through retail and wholesale channels.
The company differentiates itself by cooking chips at lower temperatures for longer periods, a practice it says preserves flavor and texture.
